description: If \(|s|\le n\) and every entry of \(s\) is at most \(m\), then \(C(s)\le B(m,n)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.code_le_bound {s : List ℕ} {m n : ℕ} (hlen : s.length ≤ n)
  (hmem : ∀ a ∈ s, a ≤ m) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.code s ≤
    Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.bound m n
